title: Call of Duty: Black Ops
provenance: Reported by crowntwo (highball-db#824, 2026-10-30), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball and engine not given (newest), DXMT and the default mode, rated 2 of 5 after 5 minutes: frame drops and freezes everywhere but the cutscenes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Starts, but a player on an M2 had frame drops and freezes outside cutscenes in DXMT mode. It's a Direct3D 9 game, which DXMT mode runs through DXVK, so the stutter is most likely shaders compiling as they first appear. Not measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Frame drops and freezes outside cutscenes (M2)
knownIssues.cause: most likely Direct3D 9 shaders compiling on first use, not measured
knownIssues.fix: Turn on DXVK async shader compilation in the environment's settings, untested here
